notes.zh: 本次为诚实化文案修订：照片导入时长边统一限制为 2200px，现在导出区与「关于」中都如实标注该上限；原图超过 2200px 被降采样时会当场提示；批量导出里的「0=原始尺寸」改为「0=保留导入后尺寸」，避免误以为能恢复原图像素（build 20）。
notes.en: Honest-label update: photos are capped at a 2200px long edge on import, and this limit is now clearly stated in the export panel and About dialog; a toast appears when an original is downscaled; the batch option '0 = original' is renamed '0 = keep imported size' so it no longer implies full original pixels can be restored (build 20).
